# jenkins — 2015 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 25 jenkins CVEs of 2015 are in `data/cve/vendors/jenkins/2015.jsonl`.

### CVE-2015-5317
- Assigner: redhat | Published: 2015-11-25 | Updated: 2025-10-21 | Max CVSS: 7.5
- CWE: n/a; CWE-200 CWE-200 Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 7.5 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=yes, Technical Impact=partial
- **CISA KEV**: added 2023-05-12, ransomware=Unknown — Jenkins User Interface (UI) Information Disclosure Vulnerability

The Fingerprints pages in Jenkins before 1.638 and LTS before 1.625.2 might allow remote attackers to obtain sensitive job and build name information via a direct request.

### CVE-2015-8103
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2015-11-25 | Updated: 2024-08-06 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 38983: Jenkins CLI - RMI Java Deserialization (Metasploit) (remote/java, 2015-12-15, verified=1)

The Jenkins CLI subsystem in Jenkins before 1.638 and LTS before 1.625.2 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted serialized Java object, related to a problematic webapps/ROOT/WEB-INF/lib/commons-collections-*.jar file and the "Groovy variant in 'ysoserial'".

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a
